name: Singapore Medical Group clinics
summary: Multi-specialty and GP options across town for routine care, specialist referrals, and cash-pay paediatric visits when panel lists are thin.
body: SMG and similar groups help when you need faster specialist access than public pathways. Bring vaccination records and prior scripts to your first visit. Foreign families paying cash/card often use private paediatric clinics for continuity while comparing unsubsidised polyclinic fees for vaccines — confirm current charges rather than assuming public equals cheap. For mental-health referrals, verify whether your insurer reimburses psychology vs psychiatry before booking a long therapy series. For dental, treat MOH fee benchmarks as a negotiation anchor and assume EP holders have no Medisave — see the dental guide. Pair with the paediatrician, dental, and mental-health guides for first-90-days planning.
